_readme: Everything drawn on a freeplay capsule. These are already the built-in defaults - the
file is here so they can be changed without rebuilding the game. Edit, back out of
freeplay and go back in; it is read fresh each time the menu is built.
Positive x moves right, positive y moves down. The *Scale entries multiply a sprite's
size. bpmDigitGap and difficultyDigitGap are the spacing between digits.
antialiasText smooths the small labels and the generated week name.
The week name is the one label set from a font rather than drawn by hand, so it has
no groove of its own. weekTextEngrave puts one back: a shadow in a colour lighter
than the capsule, offset down and right, so the letter reads as cut in with light
catching its lower lip. The colour is AARRGGBB.
